date_note: Tengrinews gives only its publication day (24 November); the page gives no earlier day for the darknet listing.
title: Claim: database said to hold Kazakh citizens' data offered on darknet; ministry says link to government systems unconfirmed
org: Ministry of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Development (Kazakhstan)
geo_basis: country named by the source; no city given
summary: Tengrinews reports a database said to belong to a Kazakh state body was offered for sale on the darknet; SOCRadar reports a user offered it for sale. The Ministry of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Development says the alleged leak concerns the Unified Portal of Judicial Authorities (ЕПСО), that the link to government systems is not confirmed and that it will report the results of a check later.
plain: SOCRadar says a seller is offering a database of Kazakh data on the darknet. The ministry says it has not confirmed any link to government systems and is checking.
exec: An unverified darknet sale claim names a Kazakh court-portal database; the ministry says the link is unconfirmed.

evidence.quote: По данным компании, база включает 507 миллионов записей из 186 таблиц за период с 2014 по 2026 год.

validation.note: Single publisher (Tengrinews), read; quotes SOCRadar's description of the listing and the ministry's reply to Tengrinews. Not independently verified.

review.note: Compared title, claimed status, severity 1, ministry reply on ЕПСО and the 507 million quote against Tengrinews
